Flat-Image (Training Set Mean).oracle_knowledge: None (uses empirical mean of training set)
Flat-Image (Training Set Mean).description: Predicts constant scalar training mean for all pixels.

Oracle Image Mean (DC-Only).description: Upper bound on any spatial DC-only flat reconstruction.

Linear Pseudoinverse (Pinv SPI).description: Exact minimum-norm solution x = H^dagger y under unregularized pseudo-inverse.

DGI (Classical SPI).description: Classical Differential Ghost Imaging with physical DC-offset restoration.

TV-CS (L1 Optimization).description: Total Variation regularized compressive sensing solver.

Raw Line-Scan Camera.photon_budget: Strictly equal (5120 photons total across 4096 pixels, ~1.25 phot/pix)
Raw Line-Scan Camera.sensor_noise: Poisson shot noise + CMOS Gaussian readout noise (sigma=2.0 e-)

Denoised Line-Scan.description: Industrial line-scan camera with spatial smoothing post-processing.

Deep SPI (ReconNet).architecture: Linear Projection (Pinv init) + 2 Residual Conv Blocks
Deep SPI (ReconNet).description: Standard feedforward deep compressive sensing benchmark.

IC-PINOT (Blind Inversion).architecture: FNO-Guided In-Context Transformer with Evidential Head and Backprojection Fusion
IC-PINOT (Blind Inversion).description: Proposed SPI reconstructor evaluated blindly without ground-truth optical parameters.
